title: Shipment Processing and Demand Notification Flow

steps: START: Admin triggers GET/POST /ShipmentServlet with (orderid, prodid, userid, amount)
ShipmentServlet.doGet(): get HttpSession → check usertype attribute
BRANCH: userType == null → sendRedirect('login.jsp?message=Access Denied') → END
Extract params: orderId, prodId, userName, amount (Double.parseDouble)
Call OrderServiceImpl.shipNow(orderId, prodId)
OrderServiceImpl.shipNow(): DBUtil.provideConnection() → PreparedStatement UPDATE orders SET shipped=1 WHERE orderid=? AND prodid=? AND shipped=0
BRANCH: rows updated > 0 → status = 'Order Has been shipped successfully!!' ELSE status = 'FAILURE'
Return status to ShipmentServlet
BRANCH: status == 'FAILURE' → pagename = 'unshippedItems.jsp'
ELSE (success): pagename = 'shippedItems.jsp' → Call MailMessage.orderShipped(userName, getFName(userName), orderId, amount)
MailMessage.orderShipped(): build HTML email body → JavaMailUtil.sendMail(recipient, subject, htmlTextMessage)
RequestDispatcher.include(request, response) with pagename
Write JS script to set status message in DOM
END Shipment Flow
START: Admin updates product with increased quantity → ProductServiceImpl.updateProduct(updatedProduct)
DB UPDATE product SET ... WHERE pid=? → if rows > 0 AND prevQuantity < updatedProduct.getProdQuantity()
BRANCH: quantity increased → trigger demand notification sub-flow
Call DemandServiceImpl.haveDemanded(prevProductId)
DemandServiceImpl.haveDemanded(): DBUtil.provideConnection() → SELECT * FROM user_demand WHERE prodid=?
Return List<DemandBean> (each with userName, prodId, demandQty)
FOR EACH DemandBean in demandList:
Call UserServiceImpl.getFName(demand.getUserName()) → get first name
Call MailMessage.productAvailableNow(demand.getUserName(), userFName, updatedProduct.getProdName(), prevProductId)
MailMessage.productAvailableNow(): build HTML email → JavaMailUtil.sendMail() [wrapped in try-catch; failure logged, not thrown]
Call DemandServiceImpl.removeProduct(demand.getUserName(), prevProductId)
DemandServiceImpl.removeProduct(): SELECT check → if exists: DELETE FROM user_demand WHERE username=? AND prodid=?
BRANCH: delete succeeds → status += ' And Mail Send to the customers who were waiting for this product!'
END LOOP
ELSE (quantity not increased): skip demand notification
END Demand Notification Flow
START: User submits contact form → GET/POST /fansMessage with (name, email, comments)
FansMessage.doGet(): extract name, email, comments from request params
Build HTML message body with fan details
Call MailMessage.sendMessage('ellison.alumni@gmail.com', 'Fans Message | name | email', htmlTextMessage)
MailMessage.sendMessage(): JavaMailUtil.sendMail() → return 'SUCCESS' or 'FAILURE' (caught MessagingException)
BRANCH: message == 'SUCCESS' → message = 'Comments Sent Successfully'
ELSE: message = 'Failed: Please Configure mailer.email and password...'
RequestDispatcher.include(request, response) for 'index.jsp'
response.getWriter().print JS alert with message
END Fans Message Flow

method_signatures: OrderServiceImpl.shipNow(orderId: String, prodId: String): String — returns 'FAILURE' or success message
DemandServiceImpl.addProduct(userId: String, prodId: String, demandQty: int): boolean
MailMessage.orderShipped(recipientEmail: String, name: String, transId: String, transAmount: double): void
MailMessage.productAvailableNow(recipientEmail: String, name: String, prodName: String, prodId: String): void
MailMessage.sendMessage(toEmailId: String, subject: String, htmlTextMessage: String): String — returns 'SUCCESS'/'FAILURE'
MailMessage.transactionSuccess(recipientEmail: String, name: String, transId: String, transAmount: double): void
JavaMailUtil.sendMail(recipient: String, subject: String, htmlTextMessage: String): void — throws MessagingException
database_operations: shipNow: UPDATE orders SET shipped=1 WHERE orderid=? AND prodid=? AND shipped=0
haveDemanded: SELECT * FROM user_demand WHERE prodid=?
removeProduct: SELECT * FROM user_demand WHERE username=? AND prodid=? → DELETE if found
addProduct (demand): SELECT check → INSERT INTO user_demand(username, prodid, quantity) if not exists
branching_conditions: ShipmentServlet: session.userType == null → redirect to login (access denied)
OrderServiceImpl.shipNow: DB rows updated > 0 → success ELSE 'FAILURE'
ShipmentServlet: status == 'FAILURE' → redirect to unshippedItems.jsp ELSE shippedItems.jsp + send email
ProductServiceImpl.updateProduct: prevQuantity < updatedQuantity → trigger demand notifications
DemandServiceImpl.haveDemanded: returns empty list if no demand exists → loop skipped
MailMessage.productAvailableNow: MessagingException caught → logged to stdout, not propagated
FansMessage: sendMessage returns 'SUCCESS' → show success alert ELSE show failure alert
important_notes: Two distinct notification channels: (1) shipment email triggered by admin action in ShipmentServlet; (2) demand notification triggered automatically in ProductServiceImpl when admin increases product quantity. DemandServiceImpl acts as a watchlist — customers are added when insufficient stock at add-to-cart time (by AddtoCart/UpdateToCart/CartServiceImpl servlets), and removed after notification. FansMessage is a separate contact/feedback notification servlet, tangentially related. MailMessage is a pure static utility class. All DB access via DBUtil.provideConnection().
